questions.q: What law did the dogs and men on the Dyea beach follow?
choices: The law of love and fellowship
The law of the Canadian Government
The law of club and fang
The law of the gold miners' camp
questions.evidence: knew no law but the law of club and fang

questions.q: What lesson did Buck take from what happened to Curly in the fight with the husky?
choices: That a dog who fights fairly will always be protected
That huskies are friendly and gentle once they get to know you well
That there was no fair play, and once down, you were finished
That the men would never let the dogs fight each other
questions.evidence: No fair play. Once down, that was the end of you.

questions.q: Why did Buck begin to hate Spitz with a bitter hatred?
choices: Spitz stole Buck's fish on their very first night
Spitz laughed while Curly was being attacked
Spitz bit Buck's shoulder when he came too close
Spitz was made leader in the place Buck wanted
questions.evidence: Spitz ran out his tongue and laughed again

questions.q: What was Buck's first job after Francois put a harness on him?
choices: Hauling a sled to the forest and back with firewood
Pulling a boat full of supplies up onto the beach
Carrying letters from the ship to the log store
Dragging heavy logs from the woods to build a cabin for the men
questions.evidence: returning with a load of firewood

questions.q: Buck's dignity was hurt "by thus being made a draught animal." What is a draught animal?
choices: An animal kept as a family pet
An animal used for pulling loads
An animal trained to guard a camp
An animal raised only for racing
questions.evidence: being made a draught animal

questions.q: Which command did Buck learn meant "go ahead"?
choices: Ho
Gee
Mush
Whoa
questions.evidence: to go ahead at "mush,"

questions.q: How were the brothers Billee and Joe different from each other?
choices: Billee was very good-natured, while Joe was sour and snarling
Billee was a strong, bold leader, while Joe was lazy and very slow
Billee was old and blind, while Joe was young and quick
Billee stole food all the time, while Joe never took any
questions.evidence: Billee's one fault was his excessive good nature

questions.q: Why did Sol-leks suddenly slash Buck's shoulder?
choices: Buck had tried to take his place in the team
Buck had come up on his blind side
Buck had eaten part of his fish ration
Buck had tangled the traces during a halt
questions.evidence: He did not like to be approached on his blind side.

questions.q: Sol-leks's name has a meaning. What does it mean?
choices: The Silent One
The Old Warrior
The Angry One
The One-Eyed Hunter
questions.evidence: which means the Angry One

questions.q: What happened when Buck first tried to sleep inside the warm tent?
choices: Perrault and Francois threw curses and pots at him until he fled
Francois let him sleep by the candle until the morning
Spitz growled at him from the corner and chased him back into the cold snow
Perrault tied him to the sled outside the tent door
questions.evidence: bombarded him with curses and cooking utensils

questions.q: How did Buck finally learn how sled dogs keep warm at night?
choices: He watched the men build a fire and lay down beside it
He found Billee curled up in a snug ball under the snow
He followed Dave into a hollow under a fallen tree
He saw Spitz crawl under the sled out of the wind
questions.evidence: curled up under the snow in a snug ball, lay Billee

questions.q: When Buck woke up buried in snow, he felt "the fear of the wild thing for the trap." Why was this strange?
choices: He had been caught in many traps back in California
He was a civilized dog who had never known a trap
The men had told him that traps were set near the camp
He had seen Curly caught in a trap the day before
questions.evidence: of his own experience knew no trap

questions.q: How did Dave and Sol-leks change once they were in harness on the trail?
choices: They became lazy and had to be whipped to keep pulling
They became alert and eager, wanting the work to go well
They became frightened and tried to slip out of the traces
They became playful and kept wrestling with the other dogs
questions.evidence: They were alert and active, anxious that the work should go well

questions.q: Why was Buck placed between Dave and Sol-leks in the team?
choices: So they could teach him the work
So he could not run away from the sled
Because he was the heaviest dog of all
Because Spitz refused to run near him
questions.evidence: so that he might receive instruction

questions.q: What did Perrault do as a rule to make the trail easier for the dogs?
choices: Travelled ahead packing the snow with webbed shoes
Rode on the sled to steer it around thin ice
Carried half the load on his own back
Stopped every single hour to let the tired dogs rest and eat
questions.evidence: packing the snow with webbed shoes

questions.q: Why did Buck always feel hungry on the trail?
choices: The men only fed him every second day to save the fish
Spitz took half of his food every single night
His daily pound and a half of dried salmon never seemed enough
He refused to eat the frozen fish the other dogs ate
questions.evidence: seemed to go nowhere

questions.q: After Buck stole a whole chunk of bacon, what happened?
choices: Perrault caught him and whipped him in front of the team
Dub was blamed and punished for what Buck had done
Spitz saw him and tried to take the bacon away
Pike told on him by howling until Francois came
questions.evidence: Dub, an awkward blunderer who was always getting caught, was punished for Buck's misdeed

questions.q: "He swiftly lost the fastidiousness which had characterized his old life." Here, "fastidiousness" means being:
choices: Very fast and quick
Fussy and dainty about things
Lazy and fond of sleeping
Brave and fond of fighting
questions.evidence: A dainty eater

questions.q: What skill did Buck develop that let him always find shelter from the wind?
choices: He could smell the wind and forecast it a night ahead
He could hear a storm coming from many miles away
He could see dark clouds long before the men could
He always followed Sol-leks, who knew the best places to sleep
questions.evidence: ability to scent the wind and forecast it a night in advance

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: How Buck plans to escape and return to Judge Miller
How Buck becomes the new leader of the dog team
How Buck learns the harsh ways of the North and his wild instincts awaken
How Perrault and Francois race across the frozen lakes to deliver gold to Seattle
questions.evidence: instincts long dead became alive again
